command:
# The payload GET smoke (docs/run.md, "The payload"): a body that only proves the stub fetched,
# verified and exec'd it. Launch with AK2_PAYLOAD_GET=role to check the run-role GET against S3
# (the conductor's mode) from the laptop; resources.s3_read_write gives the run role read on the
# results bucket, which role requires.
ak2_say "payload-get-smoke: body ran; AK2_PAYLOAD_GET=${AK2_PAYLOAD_GET:-unset}"
